emergency_helplines.hazard_type: Live Wire / Transformer Sparking / Shock Risk
emergency_helplines.action_instruction: STAY AT LEAST 10 METERS AWAY. Do NOT touch wet surfaces or puddles nearby.
Place a visible stick or barricade if safe to do so. Warn pedestrians and 2-wheeler riders.

emergency_helplines.hazard_type: Gas Leak / Chemical Fumes / Fire Hazard
emergency_helplines.action_instruction: Evacuate the immediate area upwind. Do NOT light any flame or switch on engines.
Avoid walking or driving through moving flood water. Disconnect ground-level appliances.
Do not run or make sudden eye contact. Keep children and seniors indoors.
